production.title: Leave the Door Unlatched

lyrics.text: You leave the kettle by the sink
The chipped blue cup beside the door
I count the seconds while it cools
Then count them once again, once more
You said the lock was just a lock
You said the key was mine to keep
But every time I reach for it
A voice says, wait, and I obey
I won't wait where you drew the line
I won't fold myself to fit
If you're coming, come in your own time
I can leave the door unlatched a bit
(Back: Leave it open)
I can leave the door unlatched a bit
(Back: Not forever)
Your coat is gone from the hallway hook
One sleeve of mine still smells like rain
I take the long way past the station
I don't ask who might know your name
You said the map would keep us safe
You marked the roads in careful ink
I watched the paper curl at the edge
And let the whole thing go to ash
I won't wait where you drew the line
